name: The Last Straw
description: Take turns loading the camel. Don't be the one who breaks its back. Solo, haul a Caravan town to town.

controls.action: Pick an item from the cart
Pick the left or right item
Move the item over the camel
Set off for the next town (Caravan)

badges.name: First Load
badges.description: Place your first item that holds.

badges.name: The Last Straw
badges.description: Break the camel's back with a straw.

badges.name: Steady Hand
badges.description: Land an item with the needle past the middle of the red, and it holds.

badges.name: Anvil Gift
badges.description: Hand the anvil to the next player, who breaks the back with it.

badges.name: High Rise
badges.description: A load that stands 3 m above the saddle, and holds.

badges.name: Six Towns
badges.description: Reach town 6 in one Caravan run.

badges.name: Heavy Lifter
badges.description: Deliver 1000 kg in Caravan, all runs together.

badges.name: On the Brink
badges.description: Set off in Caravan while the camel is sweating (double pay).

badges.name: Soft Touch
badges.description: Five soft landings in a row.

badges.name: Fine China
badges.description: Bring three whole vases into town on one load.

badges.name: Cat Nap
badges.description: Bring the cat into town on a load.

badges.name: Ten Towns
badges.description: Reach town 10 in one Caravan run.

badges.name: Week Streak
badges.description: Finish a daily goal seven days in a row.
